evals.name: habit-card-feature-scoped
evals.prompt: I'm working in my habit tracker app — I just scaffolded it with the course's skill. Now I need to add a HabitCard component to the habits feature. It should take a title (the habit name), a count (streak days), and an onPress callback. Drop it in src/page/habits/components/.
evals.expected_output: habit-card.component.tsx + habit-card.interface.ts written to src/page/habits/components/. index.ts updated to re-export both. Component uses theme tokens, Paper Card. Not wrapped in memo by default.

evals.name: streak-badge-with-memo
evals.prompt: Add a small StreakBadge component to src/page/habits/components/. It just shows a number and a flame icon — will be rendered inside every row of a list of habits, so let's wrap it in memo. Props: days (number).
evals.expected_output: streak-badge.component.tsx wrapped in React.memo, since user explicitly asked for it. Props type has days: number. index.ts re-exports.

evals.name: empty-state-shared
evals.prompt: I want to add a shared EmptyState component that I can use across multiple features. It takes a title and a body string, and optionally an action element to render below. Put it in src/components/ at the app level.
evals.expected_output: empty-state.component.tsx + empty-state.interface.ts in src/components/. action prop is optional (ReactNode). index.ts re-exports. No memo (single instance per screen).
